decisions.text: The new calendar sync logic ships behind a feature flag, off by default, and is turned on clinic by clinic.
Dark mode does not go into 3.2; it moves to 3.3 and is the first thing picked up next sprint.
Code freeze is a hard freeze on Friday at noon; after that only blocker fixes, approved by Rosa.
Version 3.2 is released on Monday, November 30th.

actions.what: fix the calendar sync timezone bug behind the feature flag, with an admin toggle
write a short spec of the remaining dark mode work
show Gwen in support how the flag toggle works

open_questions.text: How long the Android store review takes right now; if about four days, the build would have to be submitted before regression ends.
Who covers QA on call while Kenji is away from December 4th.
Whether to move standups to async; to be revisited after 3.2.

topics.title: Calendar sync timezone bug and feature flag
Code freeze, regression testing and release date
Release notes, support handover and store review
On-call cover during Kenji's leave and async standups

traps: Rejected proposal: Leila proposes squeezing dark mode into 3.2 (lines 26-28); Rosa rejects it (line 35). Dark mode is in 3.3, not 3.2.
Rejected date: Rosa floats Thursday the 26th as release day (line 49); it is dropped for Monday November 30th (lines 51-53).
Reassigned task: release notes are first asked of Leila (line 54), then Rosa takes them herself (line 56). The owner is Rosa.
Self-correction: Kenji says 'Thursday, no, sorry, Wednesday' (line 43). The regression is due Wednesday, not Thursday.
Task with no deadline: Leila's dark mode spec, 'no deadline, whenever you get to it' (line 39).
Not a decision: async standups, 'let's think about it and talk about it again after 3.2' (line 78).
Dates that are not deadlines: last week of October (line 14), Kenji off from December 4th (line 67), the headset arriving Thursday (line 90).
Not new actions: the admin toggle (line 25) is part of Marcus's sync fix; Leila's onboarding fixes (line 55) are existing work with no new owner or date.
